answer.summary: A “minus-one-to-one” product is a turnaround product: one that needs to be turned around rather than built from scratch or simply scaled. Cohen says these efforts can be especially hard internally because existing workflows, processes, and metrics are entrenched.

sections.heading: Meaning
sections.content: Cohen contrasts minus-one-to-one products with zero-to-one products and scaling products, defining them as turnaround products. He notes that, beyond addressing how the market perceives the product, the work is often internally difficult because entrenched workflows, processes, and metrics make change hard. He cites LinkedIn Pages as an example.
